ligand_efficiency_caveat: Vina's score divides its conformation-dependent term by (1 + 0.05846 * rotatable_bonds). Catechin and epicatechin have 2 rotatable bonds each, far fewer than most of the existing 10-compound screen (3-16). A strong raw score here is expected partly because of this normalization favoring small, rigid molecules, not purely because of binding strength. Ligand efficiency (|score|/heavy atoms) does not remove this confound, it inverts it. Report rotatable-bond count and this caveat alongside any score from this run.
